main_text.p: tenuit Leo Epist. 35. &c. Tertia est, ut quis injuriam sibi factam patienter ferat. Ubi quicquid sit de exemplo Pauli (ex quo non posse inferri ap-pellationem proprie sic dictam ad Magistratum a Censura Ecclesiastica inter alia monet Cl. Walæus p. 46. 47.) constat Sibbrandum cum praece-dentib. Theologis omnibus in re consentire. Professus autem erat p. 12. se sincere Ecclesiarum Reformatarum sententiam explicaturum. Theologis Reformatis calculum suum addit-Sapientissimus Rex Jacobus M. Britan. cujus verba ex scripto ipsius ultimo contra Cardinalem Perronium Cl. Walæus hæc laudat p. 153. quibus Rex dicit Imperatores pios cognitionem decretorum & canonum Conciliorum ac disciplinæ Ecclesiasticæ suscipere solitos fuisse &c. ut viderent an in consultationibus Episcoporum (qui æquè, inquit, obnoxii [?] sunt ambitioni atque alii homines) nihil esset contra fidelitatem Imperatori debitam, nec contra Reip.

page.notes: The line "addit-" at the end of its line is printed with a hyphen and the continuation is not clear in the scan; the word is kept as printed. "obnoxii" is doubtful in the scan (the letters look like "obncxii"). Long s is written as plain s throughout (e.g. "consentire", "Professus", "esset" for printed "confentire", "Profestus", "esset"). Italic runs in the text are marked as printed. The printed signature "D 3" is taken from the foot of the page.
